doc.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Thanks and closing
summary: Brown thanks him for the Smithsonian; Marsalis closes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay. If there’s nothing else we want to add to the historical record, I just want to say, Mr. Ellis Marsalis, on behalf of the Smithsonian Institution and the National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Masters Award, I want to thank you very much for your time, thank you very much for your contribution to American musical culture, thank you for enhancing this music that we call our own.
Smithsonian is conducting the interviews for the NEA Jazz Masters.
So this’ll be in the Smithsonian.
Yes. Like I said, it’ll be in there like with Duke and with Benny Carter and all them. They have the oral history program as part of the archives, the standing archives. So I want to say thank you.
Please keep doing what you’re doing.
Well, as long as I’m above ground, I’ll try.
